Details 
 The Carson Hat offers a timeless blend of craftsmanship and Western simplicity. This 6-panel ranch hat is made from durable wool serge for a structured yet comfortable fit. A leather oval patch embossed with the Kimes Ranch logo adds a refined touch, creating a look that’s effortlessly classic and built to last.
 Fit : Mid Profile | Curved Bill | Adjustable Snapback
 Details : 6 Panel Wool Serge, Leather Patch
